title: Real Returns Switzerland: Maud about how she restarted her career with Credit Suisse
description: Deciding to return back to work may be a challenging decision after taking a voluntarily leave from the workforce. Our Real Returns program opens the door to see what it's like today and find out what it feels like to come back while leveraging a strong support network. To learn more, please visit http://www.credit-suisse.com/realreturns  You can also follow us on:  Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/creditsuissecareers LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/company/credit-suisse

asr.full_text: I stepped away from the corporate world because my husband had an opportunity abroad. And moving to Switzerland three years ago, I felt I was no more at my place at home. And this is why I thought it was the right time for me to come back to work. Coming back to work, it's like being in the middle of the ocean. And the ReReturns programme provides us with a compass. To find our bearings within the organisation. Especially when you have senior leaders coming over to us and give us some guidance,. That's very precious and that's a real benefit for the re-returners. The highlights of the programme is a whole composition of training, mentoring, networking events. So that's really versatile and extensive and it provides us real returners,. A real springboard to relaunch our career. My biggest challenge was actually to get organized just because we have a very intense program. We need to be organised, we need to have everything in logistics ready to run. And you have to be prepared to delegate for being at your ease in your new role. After the temporary position I've been offered a permanent role which I of course accepted and. Now the next step is fulfilling this permanent position. I would give two pieces of advice to future participants. The first one is be curious. Speak to people, read about Credit Suisse,. Get new information about it,. Because you will have a flavour of the corporate culture. The second piece of advice I would give to future participants. Is to be perseverant, believe in yourself.
